Title: Azure VMware Solution now generally available in the Canada East region

Body.Content:
Azure VMware Solution empowers you to seamlessly extend or migrate on-premises VMware applications to Azure without the cost, effort or risk of re-architecting applications or retooling operations.

The release of Canada East with the existing Canada Central provides deployment choice for customers as well as two Azure VMware Solution sites within a single data sovereign geographical region. Pricing details for the new region is available at the Azure VMware Solution pricing page.

For updates on more upcoming region availability please visit the product by region page here. For further information on Azure VMware Solution please also visit the Azure VMware Solution website and documentation.
